  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Canonical is hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. The role involves managing a distributed team across regions and coordinating with partners and communities to ensure high-quality kernels across supported releases.

Location: Working from home, worldwide. We have kernel teams and openings in every time zone and, with the notable exception of Taipei, Taiwan, have no offices.

Responsibilities

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts; Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers

title: Head of Cloud Curriculum
description:
About DataCamp

DataCamp's mission is to empower everyone with the data and AI skills essential for 21st-century success. By providing practical, engaging learning experiences, DataCamp equips learners and organizations of all sizes to harness the power of data and AI. As a trusted partner to over 17 million learners and 6,000+ companies , including 80% of the Fortune 1000, DataCamp is leading the charge in addressing the critical data and AI skills shortage.

About the role

As part of our mission to make data and cloud fluency accessible to all, you’ll lead a dynamic team of instructors, content creators, and technologists to craft cutting-edge courses and projects that shape the future of cloud education. Cloud technologies are transforming how businesses operate, with platforms like AWS, Azure, and GCP at the forefront. As our Head of Cloud Curriculum, you’ll be instrumental in driving this transformation, helping learners worldwide build the skills they need to succeed.

In this role, you’ll own the cloud content strategy and roadmap, working hand-in-hand with our expert instructors and the broader Cloud Curriculum team — a talented group of educators, data scientists, and technologists. Your focus will be to continuously grow and enrich our cloud content library with impactful new materials. From courses to practice pools to real-world projects, you’ll serve as a thought partner, reviewer, and passionate advocate for our learners.

With a strong technical foundation in platforms like AWS and Azure, and the ability to influence across functions, you\'ll make data-driven decisions and successfully lead complex, high-impact projects. If you have a genuine passion for cloud education and are excited to shape the next generation of cloud professionals while building the world\'s premier network of cloud instructors, this role is for you.

About you

At DataCamp, we look for individuals who embody our core values: data-driven action, transparency, ownership, and an unwavering focus on our learners. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performing environment and are driven by a passion for democratizing access to data and cloud technologies.

Your entrepreneurial mindset and collaborative spirit push you beyond simply meeting targets — you’re motivated to empower learners worldwide to succeed in an increasingly cloud-first world. You\'re a true team player who enjoys working across functions: whether you\'re partnering with internal engineering, product, marketing, sales, and support teams, or rolling up your sleeves to strategize directly with clients, you bring energy and curiosity to every collaboration.

You believe that people, processes, technology, and data are the essential ingredients for digital transformation — and you\'re energized by the opportunity to help learners advance their cloud knowledge and skills. If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will focus your time on the following areas:

  • Define the Vision: Set the strategy for our Cloud Curriculum roadmap (AWS, Azure, GCP, cloud engineering, DevOps, and beyond).
  • Lead and Inspire: Manage a talented team of content developers and collaborate with external experts to create best-in-class learning experiences.
  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Monitor industry trends and emerging cloud technologies to keep our curriculum at the forefront.
  • Drive Impact: Build engaging, practical learning paths that help learners unlock career opportunities and enable enterprise teams to scale cloud adoption.
  • Collaborate Cross-functionally: Partner closely with product, marketing, and enterprise teams to ensure our curriculum meets the evolving needs of learners and customers.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of management experience, leading teams to success.
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience in cloud platforms like AWS or Azure.
  • Proficiency in SQL and/or Python.
  • Familiarity with cloud architecture, services, and industry best practices.
  • Cloud certifications (AWS and/or Azure) are a plus but not required.
  • Passion for working collaboratively with subject matter experts and cross-functional partners.
  • Experience with interactive technical education platforms like DataCamp or similar.
  • Ability to synthesize, visualize, and clearly communicate complex ideas, including to non-technical audiences.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Comfortable challenging ideas constructively and knowing when to push back or seek compromise to drive the best outcomes for the company.

Why Datacamp?

Joining DataCamp means becoming part of a dynamic, creative, and international start-up. Here are just a few of the reasons why you’ll love being on our team:

  • Exciting challenges: Face new technical challenges daily, keeping your work engaging and rewarding.
  • Competitive compensation: We offer a competitive salary with attractive benefits.
  • Flexibility: Benefit from flexible working hours because the future is flexible!
  • Continuous learning: Access a yearly learning budget for conferences & training to support your professional growth.
  • Global retreats: Participate in international company retreats, fostering a global team spirit.
  • Equipment: Yearly refreshment of your IT Equipment budget for your home working setup.
  • Amazing team: Collaborate with a truly exceptional team—seriously, we\'re awesome!

Our competitive compensation package offers additional benefits. On top of your salary you will also receive extra legal benefits such as best-in-class medical insurance including dental and vision. Depending on your location additional benefits might be available to you.

At DataCamp, we value diverse experiences and perspectives. If you’re excited about this role but don\'t meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. We believe skills can be developed and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. Your unique talents and perspectives are what make our team great!

title: Gerente de engenharia de manutencao
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Com mais de 35 anos de atuação nacional, ajudamos empresas a proteger vidas por meio de soluções inovadoras em redes e dispositivos móveis de comunicação crítica, assegurando segurança e bem-estar.

A Alcon e a Kofre são empresas recém-integradas, atuando em soluções especializadas de tecnologia e telecomunicações para setores estratégicos, como mineração, energia e indústrias de grande porte.

Unidas, formam um grupo que combina inovação, confiabilidade e profundo conhecimento técnico, sempre com foco em entregar soluções de alto impacto, atendimento consultivo e geração de valor sustentável para seus clientes.

Nossos valores refletem o compromisso com excelência, integridade, colaboração e inovação constante, guiando nosso trabalho em um mercado dinâmico e desafiador.

Sobre a Função

Nesta posição, você será responsável por liderar a estratégia de manutenção e a confiabilidade dos ativos de telecomunicações e rede, desde sistemas de rádio comunicação até a otimização dos processos operacionais. Seu desafio será garantir a alta disponibilidade dos equipamentos de missão crítica, liderar iniciativas de automatização de processo e rotinas, e implementar metodologias de excelência operacional que assegurem ganhos de eficiência, redução de custos e produtividade sustentável.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a gestão da estratégia de manutenção seja preditiva, preventiva e corretiva de ativos de rádio comunicação, LTE e infraestrutura de sites, assegurando a alta disponibilidade e a conformidade com as normas e contratos;
  • Conduzir tecnicamente o time de especialistas responsáveis por garantir a aderência aos requisitos e padrões técnicos, regulatórios (Anatel) e de segurança;
  • Implementar metodologias de confiabilidade de ativos e gerir os indicadores como manutenção e performance, como AMS, APM, DF, MTDF e outros;
  • Desenvolver controles das áreas de operação e manutenção como: Controle de custos, gestão absolecência, gestão de riscos, gestão de KPI s técnicos e financeiros de manutenção, e outros;
  • Conduzir análises de falhas (RCA e planos de contingência específicos para equipamentos de telecom, promovendo a segurança e a continuidade do negócio;
  • Avaliar e aprovar tecnicamente investimentos (CAPEX) equilibrando custos do ciclo de vida, riscos operacionais e perfomance da rede.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação completa em Engenharia;
  • Experiência consolidada em engenharia e manutenção de ativos (telecom, automação, elétrica e instrumentação), com atuação em redes de rádio comunicação e/ou LTDA;
  • Experiência como gestor de pessoas, conduzindo times multidisciplinares e projetos de alta complexidade;
  • Domínio em metodologias de confiabilidade de ativos, análise de falhas e gestão de projetos;
  • Vivência em área industrial nas áreas de engenharia e manutenção de máquinas, equipamentos e infraestrutura de tecnologia;
  • Inglês nível intermediário.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Habilidade para guiar e motivar a equipe durante a reestruturação e a implementação de novas metodologias;
  • Visão Analitica e Orientada a Dados;
  • Gestão de Pessoas.

Diferenciais

  • Formação em Engenharia de Telecomunicações, Automação e Elétrica;
  • Especialização em Engenharia de Manutenção.

Job overview

Provide hands-on support for successful opportunity management within the growing IQVIA Cronos Rater Services GTM team.

Cronos is part of the Applied Patient Experience Solutions team (APEx) within IQVIA Patient Centered Solutions (PCS). PCS partners with clients to help design and execute clinical trials centered around patients as well as products. Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Fast-growing company redefining custom manufacturing with high-quality inbound leads.

  • Supportive, feedback-driven culture with growth opportunities for top performers.
  • Competitive compensation + uncapped commissions; Independent Contractor role.
  • Personalized sales training for your future career; no micromanagement.

Company Values

  • Intellectually curious; asks questions and seeks to understand deeply.
  • Self-motivated with a meaningful reason to deliver excellence.
  • Good communication skills for remote collaboration and timely feedback.
  • Radical candor; coachable and able to give constructive feedback.
  • Urgency; quick decision-making and problem-solving in a dynamic environment.
  • Natural customer centricity; always consider the customer perspective.
  • Results-driven; focuses on measurable objectives.

Hiring Process

  • Hiring Manager Interview.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Information Technology Manager at Ledn. Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders and build generational wealth for the future.

Ledn offers a suite of lending, savings, and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values integrity, progress, and empathy.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The role requires wearing many hats, including end-user support, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. The right candidate will have demonstrated success in similar roles within fast-growing, security-first environments and will be passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code. You will design, implement, and manage our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks and collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholders across the organization.

You will be customer-facing and serve as the first line of support for employees via tools such as Slack and Jira. This role involves procuring and delivering technology equipment, managing onboarding and offboarding, and documenting programs, policies, and tooling. You will support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoints and MDM/EMM tools. You will contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools and write knowledge articles and automations. You will manage incidents and priorities, participate in agile sprints, and align objectives with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc., and to integrate APIs across systems.
  • Experience with SSO (Okta) and IAM workflows; familiarity with remote support across time zones.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and articles; customer-focused and able to handle frustrated users calmly.
  • Proficiency with macOS in an enterprise environment, troubleshooting, and terminal usage.
  • Experience with security practices, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs), and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and collaborate across multiple teams.
  • Nice-to-have: AWS familiarity, GAM and CLI tooling, Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications, and experience in a remote/high-growth setting.

Culture and Qualities

  • Leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment, with integrity, accountability, empathy, and a builder mindset.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and delivering results in a fast-paced, global environment.
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures.

Benefits and Environment

  • Comprehensive total rewards package, generous PTO, and ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote work opportunity for up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • Equal opportunity employer; inclusive culture; accommodation requests available during recruitment.

Additional Information

Ledn operates globally with a remote-first approach. Due to high application volumes, qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response. No agencies or recruiters, and no unsolicited resumes.

title: Comitê de ESG (Londrina Remoto)
description:
Esta oportunidade, apesar de ser remoto/digital é para residentes de Londrina e região metropolitana.

Você acredita que a educação melhora o mundo? Você quer participar de uma rede de networking de mais de 4 mil executivos e 1.000 estudantes onde, além de gerar valor para sua carreira, você também contribui para educação e combate à fome? Se a resposta é sim, venha conosco!

A PUC angels (Associação Anjos da PUC) é uma associação sem fins lucrativos que busca, por meio da educação, aprimorar o ecossistema de empreendedorismo e empregabilidade no Brasil. Acreditamos que o primeiro empreendimento de uma pessoa é sua carreira profissional. Hoje, contamos com mais de 20 colaboradores diretos e uma rede de mais de 4.000 executivos e 1.000 estudantes no Programa Anjo, que também pode incluir você – com oportunidades para atuar como mentor, executivo, empreendedor e/ou investidor.

Formato do Comitê de ESG PUC angels

O cargo é voluntário e remoto, para atuar como Membro do Comitê de ESG (com possibilidade de progressão para a posição de Líder Anjo de ESG para empresas e startups interessadas). Os membros contribuem com o ecossistema da PUC angels, auxiliando fundadores de startups, executivos e estudantes no desenvolvimento e aplicação de conhecimentos, além de participar de iniciativas e comissões conforme a demanda. Os Líderes Anjo podem liderar as Iniciativas e Comissões, conforme submetem o tema e o mesmo é aprovado pelo Presidente do Comitê.

Papéis: Membro Executivo vs. Líder Anjo do Comitê de ESG

Como Membro, você participa de reuniões gerais e abertas, assim como eventos, podendo sugerir temas para revisão, além de divulgar seu título de Membro do Comitê de em seu LinkedIn. Como Líder Anjo, terá a oportunidade de liderar Comissões e Iniciativas, assumir diretorias do comitê, submeter temas para avaliação da Presidência, e poderá concorrer à liderança do Comitê, participando de eventos exclusivos para Líder Anjos e outros associados.

Qualificações:

  • Interesse e paixão pelo tema do Comitê de ESG
  • Capacidade de pensar estrategicamente e aplicar conhecimentos na prática
  • Paixão por contribuir para a sociedade por meio da educação
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento
  • Habilidade de trabalho remoto e proativo
  • Envolvimento com o tema do comitê
  • Proficiência em português (inglês e espanhol são diferenciais pois a PUC angels está expandindo)
  • Paciência e habilidade para ensinar e motivar

Por que Participar como Membro ou Líder Anjo no Comitê de ESG da PUC angels?

  • Ganhe visibilidade no mercado, destacando-se como um Líder Anjo do Comitê de ESG da PUC angels
  • Tenha impacto direto no ecossistema de inovação e mudanças de mercado, assumindo uma posição de liderança
  • Acrescente experiência e o título de Membro Executivo /Líder Anjo do Comitê de ESG da PUC angels ao seu perfil profissional
  • Expanda seu networking com mais de 4.000 executivos, 1.000 alunos e empreendedores
  • Participe como mentor, conselheiro, investidor e/ou empreendedor dentro do ecossistema de networking da PUC angels
  • Escolha as frentes em que deseja atuar ou explore todas as oportunidades que oferecemos

Atividades do Comitê

  • Reuniões online: Sessões periódicas sobre temas de mercado e painéis com profissionais de destaque
  • Produção de artigos: Elaboração de conteúdos sobre novidades e dados de mercado
  • Regulamentações: Participação em grupos para regulamentação de iniciativas, com interação direta com executivos, empresas, governo e outras associações via PUC angels

Oportunidades Complementares

  • Possibilidade de investir em projetos já existentes
  • Sessões de pitch (online e presenciais), eventos de aceleração e parcerias estratégicas
  • Atuação como Mentor ou Conselheira Anjo para startups e estudantes

Networking e Eventos

  • Acesso a grupos exclusivos no WhatsApp e LinkedIn
  • Participação em eventos temáticos presenciais e online promovidos pela PUC angels e Comitês, em locais de destaque como a Tuca da PUC SP, Inovabra e FIEP

Objetivo dos Comitês PUC angels

Promover a evolução e integração dos mercados em que atua através do conhecimento e networking, atuando, quando necessário, na regulamentação necessária para que cada mercado cresça de forma sustentável.

Missão PUC angels

Melhorar o mundo através da educação e do combate à fome.

Objetivo do Comitê de ESG PUC angels

Promover o empreendedorismo de ESG, networking e inovação, fortalecendo empresas, ampliando a empregabilidade e gerando valor para todas as pessoas envolvidas.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Flex is building a finance super app for premium business owners — reimagining every single aspect of the financial workflow and financial services for any entrepreneur. The company has grown revenue 25x+ since publicly launching in September 2023 and is on track to achieve profitability by late 2025. Flex is focused on mid-market businesses ($3 - $100M revenue) that are largely overlooked by existing fintech solutions and reliant on slow and outdated regional banks. We are targeting a ~$1T revenue opportunity that is largely up for grabs.

Flex is a fully remote company and this role can be performed from anywhere.

About the Role

We're looking for a Software Engineer II to help build product features that power financial services. You'll work on systems that handle payments, credit, and other core products that our customers rely on daily to drive business operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full lifecycle of medium-sized features and tasks across our product stack
  • Build user-facing features, internal tools, APIs, and backend services
  • Write clear, maintainable, and tested code that you'll be responsible for long-term
  • Participate in code reviews and provide timely feedback to teammates
  • Build features with the end product and user in mind, not just the code
  • Reason carefully about how your work extends in service of larger product needs
  • Build upon systems and features that others depend on
  • Balance speed with reliability and compliance in a regulated environment
  • Collaborate with other engineers and product team members to deliver high-impact work

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Have strong fundamentals in software development and ability to work effectively within established systems
  • Product sense—you think about the user impact and business value of your work
  • Ability to take responsibility for the maintenance and quality of what you build
  • Experience with financial services, regulated industries, or handling sensitive data is a plus but not required
  • Ability to research and proactively solve problems, bring solutions to the table
  • English proficiency
  • A strong work ethic
  • Technical environment: We primarily use Typescript, PostgreSQL, and GCP. We are building in a monorepo with a lean towards rapid value creation through trunk based development. Deploying to production 3-5 times a week is the average velocity of a team member.
  • What matters to us: We value ownership, product sense, and clear communication. You should be someone who thinks beyond just shipping code to understanding the impact on users and the business. We're a small team, so everyone wears multiple hats and jumps in where needed.

Why Join Us

Flex is growing quickly — you’ll help shape the direction of a product and company with real momentum.

We’re well-capitalized with strong backing and a clear long-term vision.

You’ll work with a sharp, driven team that values autonomy, clarity, and quality.

Join ambitious builders who care deeply about winning together — and having fun while doing it.

Annual team on-sites. From Bogota to Mexico City, the entire Flex team gets together once a year to align and build camaraderie.

title: Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Canonical has a large and rapidly growing kernel team that underpins Ubuntu and open source more widely across a very wide range of hardware and use cases. We partner with the biggest kernel contributors - the silicon companies - to ensure that their work reaches the widest possible audience as quickly as possible, with a 10 year enterprise security commitment.

The Canonical Linux Kernel Organization has teams in every time zone. We have opportunities for technical leadership, engineering management, and engineering directorships. The team is responsible for all supported Ubuntu Linux kernels, on all platforms and architectures from small embedded devices to standard desktop/server systems to large scale cloud environments, mainframes and supercomputers.

We care most about hardware and virtualization enablement, security, reliability and performance. There are a number of areas where we lead upstream, but for the most part we are interested in ensuring production readiness and performance for the latest patch-sets, rather than subsystem maintenance or evolution.

Kernel Team projects include but are not limited to:

  • Ubuntu Linux kernel plan, execution, benchmarking and stress testing
  • Optimized kernels for key silicon and cloud partners
  • Confidential computing and next-generation security primitives
  • Developer platforms such as Raspberry Pi and RISC-V
  • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Kernel Livepatch, which delivers critical kernel fixes without rebooting
  • FIPS compliance
  • Real-Time and Low Latency kernel variants and patch-sets
  • Virtualization or abstraction engines
  • Container technology
  • Security with AppArmor, SECCOMP, namespaces and more
  • Networking - in particular performance and security
  • Storage - we are particularly interested in Ceph and DRBD

We hire candidates of all experience levels from recent university graduates through seasoned industry experts. We select those who are enthusiastic to work in multiple areas including security mitigation, feature development, patching and test. You must have outstanding academic results, a background in software engineering, be motivated to work in a distributed team and willing to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events.

Location: Working from home, worldwide. We have kernel teams and openings in every time zone and – with the notable exception of Taipei, Taiwan – have no offices and therefore no pressure to work from an office.

What the role entails

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of a flavour of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Solid background with git
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Understanding of Linux kernel upstream processes and release cycle
  • Performance engineering and security experience
  • Solid background in CI/CD and process automation
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Overview

Join to apply for the Project Assistant, Abrolhos Carbon role at Conservation South Africa

Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY - This position is based in Brazil (remote), preferably in Espirito Santo or Bahia; candidates must reside in Brazil. To apply for this position, please submit your application using this site: CI-Brasil | Assistente de projeto, Carbono Abrolhos.

The Project Assistant for CI-Brasil’s Carbono Abrolhos initiative supports the implementation of the project, with a special focus on activities in the states of Bahia and Espírito Santo. Responsibilities include contributing to the technical planning of field and operational activities related to climate finance projects and carbon credit origination.

The role involves assisting in the preparation of technical progress reports, supporting and monitoring the activities of implementing partners to ensure planned deliverables and expected results are met, and helping to engage local partners and final beneficiaries.

The assistant compiles and provides information that supports project implementation and collaborates with other teams, particularly those involved in Climate Finance initiatives and the Restoration Directorate. Finally, the role supports the alignment of project activities with the institution’s mission and strategic objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Support for the Implementation of Carbon Credit Origination and Climate Finance Projects
  • Support the implementation of carbon credit origination and climate finance projects at CI-Brasil, contributing to planning, refining deliverables, and improving outcomes linked to the Climate Solutions Directorate. This includes efforts to achieve programmatic and project goals, covering indicators related to financing, people benefited, carbon, and compliance with social and environmental safeguards.
  • Conduct monitoring and evaluation—both in the field and remotely—of the implementation of different phases of carbon credit origination projects and activities carried out by local partners (planning, contracting, engagement, monitoring, and closure), analysis of technical reports, and input into monitoring platforms.
  • Support administrative tasks related to project implementation and stakeholder engagement across different phases of the carbon credit origination process. This includes organizing events, training sessions, producing outreach materials, coordinating technical visits, participating in meetings, and preparing drafts and records.
  • Project Implementation and Monitoring
  • Support data collection, organization, and systematization related to participating properties (e.g., registration data, available area, land-use practices, etc.).
  • Assist in consolidating technical information required for project audits and third-party verifications.
  • Ensure spreadsheets and databases are kept up to date, maintaining consistency and data quality for technical and financial reporting.
  • Support the preparation of materials for technical meetings, field visits, and certification or verification audits.
  • Contribute to field logistics for engagement, monitoring, or auditing activities (e.g., scheduling, transportation, materials, etc.).
  • Assist in tracking work plans and timelines, flagging any delays or deviations to the coordination team, especially those related to monitoring activities.
  • Communication and Stakeholder Engagement
  • Support communication and relationship-building with rural landowners participating in the project, answering questions and organizing necessary information to ensure engagement.
  • Assist in organizing meetings, trainings, and workshops with landowners and partners, including logistical support and activity documentation.
  • Contribute to the preparation of simplified reports on the progress of activities with producers and local partners.
  • Help systematize stories, best practices, and lessons learned from the project to support communication materials and donor reporting.
  • Engage with local partners and project beneficiaries through meetings, events, and presentations, helping to maintain stakeholder engagement, especially with rural producers. Support project outreach and engagement during meetings and events as determined by project managers.
  • Participate in field activities related to carbon monitoring (e.g., forest inventories, socio-environmental data collection, and verification of compliance with applicable methodologies).
  • Support the development of specific MRV (Measurement, Reporting, and Verification) carbon reports, ensuring quality, clarity, and alignment with internationally recognized standards and methodologies (e.g., GHG Protocol, VCS, CCB).

Working conditions

  • Flexible, with frequent field presence in projects located in Southern Bahia and Espírito Santo.
  • Involvement in both administrative tasks and field activities.
  • Regular in-person participation required for meetings, field trips, and other activities, both nationally and internationally, including travel to remote regions within Brazil.
  • Preferably based in the project implementation region – Bahia or Espírito Santo.

Qualifications

Required
  • Up to 2 years of experience in carbon credit origination projects, preferably in forest restoration initiatives.
  • Technical and/or practical knowledge in ecology, conservation, restoration, and carbon projects.
  • Experience with project monitoring and data collection platforms.
  • Ability to support and conduct Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) processes within project contexts.
  • Experience in preparing technical reports and meeting minutes.
  • Strong skills in structuring and facilitating workshops.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and adapt in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel frequently within the country.
  • Availability for frequent travel.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and intermediate English (with the ability for technical communication) is desirable.
  • Previous experience in the non-profit/NGO sector is an asset.
  • University degree in Environmental Management, Forest Engineering, Biological Sciences, Environmental Engineering, or related fields.

To apply for this position, please submit your resume and cover letter.

Overview

Onco360 is searching for an Inside Sales Representative - Oncology. This is a fully remote position. Onco360 Pharmacy is a unique oncology pharmacy model created to serve the needs of community, oncology and hematology physicians, patients, payers, and manufacturers.

A career with us is more than just a job. It''s an opportunity to connect and care for our patients, providers, communities and each other. We attract extraordinary people who have a strong desire to live our mission - to better the lives of those battling cancer and rare diseases. Compassion is more important than numbers. We value teamwork, respect, integrity, and passion. We succeed when you do, and our company and management team work hard to foster an environment that provides you with opportunities for both professional and personal growth.

Base Salary range $55k-$70k annually; plus Commission

Summary

Using a balance of account management and direct telephone outreach, the primary responsibility of the Inside Sales position will be to develop and manage a designated territory with the goal of providing education and care coordination to prescribers for all Onco360 products and services. This position acts as a single point of contact by assisting the prescriber in evaluating referrals and performing care coordination to ensure service level requirements are met. In most cases this responsibility is carried out in coordination with a mirrored outside sales representative. The targeted customers are physicians, NPs, PAs, nursing staff, office managers, administrative and pharmacy staff within both hospital and community oncology settings.

This position will be home based with minimal travel as required to execute the following:

Major Responsibilities

  • Seeks out opportunities for prescriber experience process improvement and collaborates with Pharmacy OPS and outside sales to achieve prescriber experience improvement and sales goals
  • Achieves designated call expectations for assigned prescribers with a focus on top targets, key influencers, and pipeline leads
  • Responsible for identifying, ranking, prospecting, and developing key oncology practice and hospital-based business relationships within targeted regional territory
  • Assists with sales escalations and communicates routinely with field sales representative partner about details impacting prescriber or patient experience
  • Supports education and delivery of key messages and product presentations within initiatives (i.e. Selling our Success communication, drug launches, etc.) designed to ensure territory meets performance requirements
  • Responsible for forwarding calls pertaining to clinical information and questions (i.e., dosing directions, adverse events, counseling, etc.) to Staff Pharmacists
  • Documents and meticulously makes notations in each patient’s profile and/or CRM regarding every update and aspect of a customer’s/physician’s care or needs
  • Uses discretion and independent judgment in handling customer complaints received, while documenting and forwarding to appropriate administrative staff.
  • Obtains and manages prescriber communication preferences
  • Nurtures and manages prescriber relationship to improve loyalty, and retention.
  • Utilizes SPOC Tool to ensure all SPOC account prescriptions are processed quickly and efficiently throughout the workflow process.
  • Assists operations staff and prescriber offices with prior authorizations by following up on outstanding issues and assisting with coordination and communication.
  • Ensure that prescription renewal requests are communicated in a timely manner to ensure continuity of care when applicable.
  • Works collaboratively with sales to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals

Regional Director Qualifications

  • 2 years’ retail or specialty pharmacy technician experience preferred - Must be familiar with general pharmacy terminology, billing quantity, SIG codes, roman numerals, brand, and generic names of medications, and IV dosage calculations/day supply.
  • 2 years inside or outside sales experience for pharmacy or other health services-related industry preferred
  • Oncology sales experience desired but not required
  • Exceptional probing and consultative communication skills
  • Familiar with oncology providers, drugs, clinic, and hospital communities
  • Understanding of oncology drug reimbursement, Managed Care Medical Specialty and PBM drug benefits
  • Self-motivated and results driven
  • Highly effective in working objectively with a diverse group of people and must demonstrate communication, organizational, administrative and office skills
  • Proficient in data entry, verbal skills, computer skills and the ability to learn the department’s software system including CRM
  • Must be a team player willing to accept and promote organizational goals and function with minimal supervision
  • Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, employees, or senior management
  • Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as statistical inference. Ability to apply concepts such as percentages, ratios, and proportions in practical solutions

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).

  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tooling.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability; collaborative and empathetic across functions and cultures.

  • Experience working in a remote environment.

You may reach out to the Ledn team for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses! All positions are CLT.

You can learn more about InComm Payments by visiting our Website or connecting with us on LinkedIn , YouTube , Twitter , Facebook , or Instagram .


About This Opportunity

Join our lean and dynamic NOC team as a NOC Technician, where you will play a key role in maintaining the operational excellence of our network. This position is ideal for someone with a basic understanding of networking concepts and a strong willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, 24/7/365 environment. As part of our team, you will be responsible for monitoring alerts, managing emails and tickets, and escalating issues to ensure continuous network performance.
Given the lean nature of our NOC, flexibility is crucial. While your primary schedule will be 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, you must be open to shift changes and occasional late-night deployments to support live monitoring of our network resources during those deployments.


Responsibilities
  • Monitor network alerts using tools such as Solar Winds, Thousand Eyes, Pingdom, or Splunk.
  • Respond to emails and manage tickets in ServiceNow ITSM.
  • Escalate issues to more experienced team members when necessary.
  • Participate in shift changes and late-night deployments as needed.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure continuous network operations and quick resolution of incidents.

Qualifications
  • 1–2 years of experience in a networking or IT support role.
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, VPN, routing).
  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools and ticket management systems (ServiceNow experience is a plus).
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including nights and weekends as needed.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn.
  • Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration and knowledge sharing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experi- ence preferred.
  • CCNA or other entry-level networking certifications are a plus.
  • Experience with AVI and F5 load balancers.
  • Familiarity with Cisco and Palo Alto network devices.
  • Knowledge of Itential automation tools and Ansible.
  • Experience with network monitoring tools such as Solar Winds, Thousand Eyes, Pingdom, or Splunk.

ENTREGAS PARA ESTA DEMANDA:

Revisar tecnicamente o mapa de conteúdo e o conteúdo bruto (texto), garantindo precisão conceitual e adequação didática. Os temas incluem:

  • Evolução do cavalo e influência no comportamento alimentar;

  • Formulação de dietas equilibradas e boas práticas no fornecimento;

  • Manejo alimentar diário de equinos: horários, quantidades, ajustes por categoria, adaptação e transição de dietas;

  • Armazenamento e conservação de alimentos e suplementos: controle de pragas, temperatura, ventilação e higiene;

Nível superior completo em Zootecnia ou Medicina Veterinária (ou áreas correlatas com experiência comprovada em nutrição animal);

Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn\'s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.

A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You\'ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You\'re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints). You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite. Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you\'re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone\'s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You\'re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data. Nice to Haves: Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.) You\'ve used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications. Culture Fit: We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The ideal candidate will: Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do. title: Especialista de Transporte, Sort Center
description:
Overview

Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil - F95

O SC (Sort Center) está em busca de profissionais engajados e apaixonados por inovação para ajudar a desenvolver um processo logístico de classe mundial, garantindo entregas dentro do prazo e com a máxima eficiência de custo. O objetivo da nossa equipe é operar com excelência, otimizando capacidades e monitorando em tempo real as operações do Sort Center no Brasil, realizando o acompanhamento hora a hora e fornecendo análises detalhadas dos dados operacionais.

Essa posição requer um profissional proativo e com espírito de liderança. Você representará uma posição estratégica nas operações de transporte da Amazon, enquanto trabalhamos constantemente para melhorar os níveis de serviço, a eficiência das capacidades e a otimização dos custos do Sort Center Brasil. Isso garantirá que as promessas feitas aos nossos valiosos clientes sejam cumpridas de forma consistente.

Uma pessoa especialista em operações de transporte facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas (transportadoras/hubs/armazéns) e resolve quaisquer possíveis problemas que afetem a experiência do cliente e a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, trabalhará em operações externas com relacionamento FCs / ATS Middle Mile / TOM e AMZL, garantindo que nossas capacidades sejam sempre atingidas com excelência e ainda garantindo a visibilidade dessas capacidades para as áreas parceiras e para a gerência sênior da operação.

Como especialista em transporte, você deve ser capaz de resolver problemas com agilidade, utilizando ferramentas internas e tomando decisões assertivas em tempo real. É essencial compreender os requisitos, analisar dados, identificar tendências e impulsionar a experiência do cliente sem impactar os prazos estabelecidos. Conhecimentos básicos em logística e habilidades de comunicação claras, tanto na forma escrita quanto oral, são indispensáveis. Além disso, o profissional deve propor melhorias nos processos e ter a determinação de implementá-las até a conclusão.

Essa posição estará envolvida na expansão do Sort Center no Brasil, trabalhando em turnos de 3x2. Modelo de trabalho: Presencial, em turnos pela escala 3x2. É necessário ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários/turnos/áreas flexíveis, incluindo fins de semana, noites e/ou feriados.

Key job responsibilities

  • Estabelecer comunicação eficiente com clientes externos (ATS Middle Mile, TOM, Time de Operações do Sort Center e AMZL) e clientes internos (centros de atendimento ROC, estações de entrega);
  • Possuir capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados (usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados) e realizar relatórios e análises ad hoc conforme necessário é um diferencial desejável;
  • Desenvolver e/ou compreender métricas de desempenho relevantes para impulsionar os resultados do negócio;
  • Entender rapidamente o impacto das tendências nos resultados comerciais e tomar decisões com base nos dados disponíveis;
  • Encaminhar de forma estruturada problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes, garantindo a execução de soluções;
  • Trabalhar dentro de várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, mensurando e identificando as atividades realizadas;
  • Responder pelo gerenciamento de capacidade de linha e gerenciamento de volume, incluindo a realização de uploads de limites de capacidade no sistema;
  • Garantir visibilidade às atividades de Capacidades, fornecendo suporte direto ao time de operações.

A day in the life

O Sort Center é o Middle Mile (MM), uma parte da estrutura da Amazon Transportation Service (ATS), onde os pacotes são enviados para serem consolidados de diferentes origens e serem classificados e enviados ao destino para melhorar a velocidade de entrega, a ocupação do veículo e a frequência da rota. A estratégia do Sort Center para o Brasil tem como objetivo desenvolver nossa rede de transporte apoiando a expansão dos programas da AMZL, Amazon Air e Market Place.

A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Você precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. A função envolve:

Responsabilidades

  • Monitoramento do andamento das rotas, atuando de forma proativa para identificar e corrigir desvios e adequar, com foco na superação da expectativa do cliente e no gerenciamento dos custos de operação.
  • Condução de reuniões, atribuição de funções e supervisão de atividades ligadas a KPIs como despacho pontual, sucesso na entrega no primeiro dia (On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success) e aprimoramento do atendimento ao cliente.
  • Ficar obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para impulsionar as melhorias.
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal.
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante o lançamento / implementação de sistemas / processos mais novos e coletar feedback.
  • Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir as operações normais do dia a dia. Garantir que os associados tenham ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
  • Comunicar as métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos em Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

Overview

Join to apply for the Paid Media Specialist role at Bluelight .

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team. This position suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where opinions and efforts are valued. You will contribute to challenging projects and develop high-quality applications. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that supports professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply.

Responsibilities

  • Managing Google Ads Campaigns: Launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns across Search, Display, and Video.
  • Bottom-of-Funnel Focus: Prioritize conversions that go beyond lead generation, including SQLs, pipeline impact, and closed-won revenue.
  • Collaboration with Sales Teams: Partner closely with sales to align on lead quality, refine campaign targeting, and maintain a strong feedback loop.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Create dashboards and evaluate campaign results using Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and spreadsheets.
  • Full-Funnel & Lead Quality Insights: Deep knowledge of the buyer journey and how paid media influences progression through the funnel.
  • A/B Testing & Creative Iteration: Conduct tests on targeting, ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding tactics to drive performance gains.
  • Cross-Channel Integration: Collaborate with the broader marketing team to maintain cohesive messaging and strategic alignment across all channels.
  • Landing Page & CRO Collaboration: Coordinate with design teams to enhance landing page effectiveness and improve conversion rates.
  • Budget Management & Forecasting: Manage spend pacing and performance targets, with clear reporting on ROI and CAC.
  • Platform Expansion: Research and experiment with emerging ad formats and placements within Google Ads.

Qualifications

  • Expertise in Google Ads: 5+ years of hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across Google Search, Display, and Video.
  • Full-Funnel Focus: Skilled in tracking and optimizing campaigns beyond top-of-funnel leads, with emphasis on revenue.
  • Strong Analytical Abilities: Proficiency in Google Analytics, spreadsheets, Looker Studio (or similar tools), and analyzing campaign performance data.
  • Collaboration with Sales: Experience partnering with sales teams to enhance campaign impact on the sales pipeline.
  • Advanced Conversion Tracking: Knowledge of UTM parameters, pixel setup, and Google Tag Manager usage.
  • Proficient in English: Effective communication across teams and documentation.
  • CRM Awareness: Understanding of how paid media campaigns connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

What You’ll Achieve

  • Drive higher revenue attributed to marketing through Google Ads campaigns.
  • Improve SQL rates and lead-to-deal conversions via paid media.
  • Develop a collaborative workflow with the sales team to assess and refine lead quality.
  • Lower CPA while improving ROAS and CAC efficiency.
  • Expand a full-funnel paid media strategy aligned with customer purchasing behaviors.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. You will work with modern technologies and collaborate with talented professionals, contributing to clients’ success and your own growth.

title: Security Engineer
description:
About Ledn

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. Our team is diverse and united by a conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. You will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Responsibilities

  • Application Security: Lead secure design and code reviews; define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services; automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD; conduct threat modeling and risk assessments; partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities.
  • Authentication & Identity: Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications; enhance Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger MFA solutions (WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens); align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows; define secure session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves): Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads; integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs; migrate high-value operations into enclave environments; ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience.
  • Additional Security Domains: Harden AWS services with least-privilege IAM and secure key management; improve Kubernetes security posture; deploy and operate a SIEM framework with detection rules and incident playbooks; support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001).

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale information security practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Competitive total rewards package that starts on day one, including equity ownership in Ledn.
  • Remote-friendly work arrangement with global teams; opportunity to work remotely up to 180 days per year where permitted.
  • Comprehensive benefits and a purpose-driven career in the digital asset space.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusivity. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals. You may reach out to accommodate requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Working Environment

Ledn is global and remote-first, with team members across North America, Latin America, Europe, and Africa. Due to high application volume, only qualified candidates will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

Reconhecemos que nossos colaboradores são a força motriz por trás do nosso sucesso, e é por isso que priorizamos uma experiência que favorece o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal único de cada pessoa. title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers :

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Build and Refine AI Products

  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

3. Highly Valued Qualifications

  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We\'ll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

  • Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

  • Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast-paced environment where you\'ll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you\'re a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Global Partner Marketing & Operations Manager
description:
360Learning is looking for a Partner Marketing & Operations Manager to architect and scale the next generation of our global partner ecosystem. This is a highly strategic role at the intersection of marketing, alliances, operations, and growth, ideal for someone who wants to build and own the engine behind one of the fastest-growing partner programs in SaaS.

Your mission: turn our partner program into a world-class growth platform. You will design and orchestrate how we communicate, operate, and scale partnerships internally and externally. This means structuring clear, impactful enablement for our internal teams, while also building the marketing motions and engagement strategies that elevate our partners externally. You’ll harness AI agents, automation, and data to improve how we deliver partner intelligence, streamline collaboration, and amplify partner impact across the business.

Reporting directly to the Director of EMEA Alliances and collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and Finance, you’ll be the driving force behind how we structure, market, and shine our partner program. Overview

Responsibilities

Within 1 month, you will

  • Immerse yourself in our partner ecosystem, understanding our GTM strategy, current partner motions, and the opportunities ahead
  • Audit existing processes, documentation, and partner communications to identify quick wins and strategic priorities
  • Get hands-on with our tech stack (Salesforce, Atlassian tools, Looker, Dust) and explore how AI and automation can elevate partner engagement and enablement
  • Build relationships across Sales, CS, Product, Marketing, and Finance to align on how partnerships can create impact across the business

Within 3 months, you will

  • Intelligence at scale: Deploy AI-powered tools and workflows to deliver real-time partner insights and automate internal communications, increasing productivity across the revenue org
  • Launch an improved partner newsletter and communication cadence, backed by clear engagement metrics and feedback loops

Within 6 months, you will

  • Scale operational excellence: Automate key workflows; from onboarding to content distribution to marketplace updates, making our partner program more efficient and more visible
  • Drive engagement: Launch targeted, data-driven marketing campaigns (high-touch and low-touch) that deepen partner collaboration and generate measurable pipeline influence
  • Be the source of truth: Build a comprehensive partner intelligence layer that helps internal teams act faster, sell smarter, and deliver greater value
  • Shape GTM impact: Partner with Sales and Marketing leadership to design joint initiatives that expand partner-sourced pipeline and accelerate customer adoption
  • Demonstrate a measurable lift in partner engagement (via newsletter open/click rates, shared content, or co-marketing activity) and direct impact on sourcing
  • Launch a scalable digital-first approach to improve the scale and impact of our Tier 3 partnerships

Within 12 months, you will

  • Be recognized as a key partner to the Alliances team for partner enablement and marketing strategy

  • Hands-on familiarity or strong willingness to learn Salesforce and the Atlassian suite (Confluence, Jira, Trello, Salesforce), and demonstrated understanding and use of AI Agent tools to create efficiency is a bonus

  • Fluency in English and French; German is a plus
  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained in the knowledge base

What We Offer

360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth.
